title: IYKYK (But AI Doesn’t): Automated Content Moderation Does Not Capture Communities’ Heterogeneous Attitudes Towards Reclaimed Language
reasoning: The paper evaluates content moderation (hate speech detection) through the lens of value pluralism and moral pluralism. It explicitly discusses the alignment of AI systems to human values and norms, the 'moral status' of reclaimed slurs, and uses normative decision pathways to analyze how different communities interpret language.
